headline: IBM Shares Fall 5% in Premarket After Third-Quarter Results
summary: Shares of International Business Machines dropped 5 percent in premarket trading on Thursday as investors evaluated the company's third-quarter results while still contending with a July earnings miss.
why: IBM is a major global provider of enterprise IT infrastructure, cloud solutions, and consulting services. Its quarterly performance is watched as an indicator of broader corporate technology spending.

impacts.name: IBM
impacts.why: Premarket share prices slid 5% as investors digested third-quarter financial figures.

why_moved: IBM shares slid 5% in premarket trading as investors evaluated the firm's third-quarter earnings report following an earlier earnings miss in July.
